results.message: SSO button and token input are both visible on /login
Clicking SSO button navigates to Keycloak authorization endpoint with PKCE params
Real Keycloak login succeeds and workspace AppShell is shown
Navigating to /auth/callback with error params redirects to /login?reason=auth-error
Logout after OIDC login navigates to Keycloak end-session endpoint
